summary: Full end-to-end validation of UDAMG APP (Church evangelism app). Backend pytest suite (14 tests) covers auth, RBAC, villes/familles/contacts CRUD, evenements, invitations (admin-only, special), and stats — all pass 100% against the Emergent preview URL. Frontend Expo web preview flow tested via Playwright at mobile viewport (390x844): splash auto-redirects to login, admin credentials pre-fill correctly, login navigates to Menu Principal (2 large cards), Évangélisation → Villes(4) → Familles(4 for Angers) → Contacts navigation works, quick-add bottom sheet creates contact, Événements list shows 4 events, event detail shows 'Inviter les anciens' button (admin-only), invite screen lists members with checkboxes, invitation is sent and coordination counters update (1 Invités / 1 ✨ Anciens), Profile logout returns to /login. Design is clean minimalist white with royal blue accents; French copy consistent.

issues: Non-blocking React Native web warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop into StyleSheet to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional test hygiene) test_evenements_seeded returns a list; convert 'return evts' to assertion to remove PytestReturnNotNoneWarning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: solid MVP — argon2 via pwdlib, JWT with iss/exp/jti/sub/require options, DUMMY_HASH timing-attack mitigation, admin RBAC via require_admin, MongoDB _id excluded from all response models (uses id from _id).
Seed is idempotent for villes/familles/evenements (count check) and admin/member users (email lookup). Good.
invitations collection has unique index (evenement_id, user_id) — duplicate invites silently skipped (created counter tracks new inserts). Behavior verified.

Frontend testIDs coverage is thorough on every interactive element (login, menu cards, ville-row-*, famille-card-*, contacts-fab, contact-form-submit, evenement-card-*, event-invite-elders, invite-user-*, invite-send, profile-logout-button).
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway 'TEST_' contact during contact-flow test then deleted it. Registered one throwaway member user via /auth/register (email test_<uuid>@udamg.app) — left in DB but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://church-connect-255.preview.emergentagent.com). Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_udamg_api.py runs in ~2.5s and validates all core endpoints + RBAC.
